! Game text
| '''0 side — He Is The Chosen One'''<br />''Deploy Jedi Council Chamber (with Prophecy Of The '''For'''ce there), Ewok Village, and I Feel The Conflict.'' For remainder of game, you may not deploy [Episode I] Jedi (except Yoda) {{Errata hl|1=or [Episode I] padawans}}. Luke may not be captured by Bring Him Before Me unless there are 2 or more cards stacked on Insignificant Rebellion during any move phase. '''While''' this side up, you may initiate battles for free. '''Flip''' this card if Luke {{Errata hl|1=(}}or a Jedi{{Errata hl|1=)}} at a battleground site and opponent has no characters of ability &gt; 4 at battleground sites.<br />'''7 side — He Will Bring Balance'''<br />'''While''' this side up, once during your control phase, may peek at up to X cards from the top of your Reserve Deck, where X = number of battlegrounds you occupy; take one into hand and shuffle your Reserve Deck. During your draw phase, may retrieve any one card; opponent may stack a card from hand on I Feel The Conflict to place that card out of play instead. '''Flip''' this card (unless Vader crossed over) if opponent's character of ability &gt; 4 at a battleground site or you do not have Luke (or a Jedi) at a battleground site. || '''0 side — He Is The Chosen One'''<br />''Deploy Jedi Council Chamber (with Prophecy Of The '''For'''ce there), Ewok Village, and I Feel The Conflict.'' For remainder of game, you may not deploy [Episode I] {{Errata hl|1=or [Episode VII] characters or locations}} (except {{Errata hl|1=Obi-Wan and}} Yoda). Luke may not be captured by Bring Him Before Me unless there are {{Errata hl|1=two}} cards stacked on Insignificant Rebellion during any move phase. '''While''' this side up, you may initiate battles for free. '''Flip''' this card if Luke or a Jedi at a battleground site {{Errata hl|1=(unless an opponent's character}} of ability &gt; 4 {{Errata hl|1=is)}}.<br />'''7 side — He Will Bring Balance'''<br />'''While''' this side up, once during your control phase, may peek at up to X cards from the top of your Reserve Deck, where X = number of battlegrounds you occupy; take one into hand and shuffle your Reserve Deck. During your draw phase, may retrieve any one card; opponent may stack a card from hand on I Feel The Conflict to place that card out of play instead. '''Flip''' this card (unless Vader crossed over) if opponent's character of ability &gt; 4 at a battleground site or you do not have Luke (or a Jedi) at a battleground site. || — || '''0 side — He Is The Chosen One'''<br />''Deploy ''{{Errata hl|1=''Anakin's Funeral Pyre''}}'' (with Prophecy Of The '''For'''ce there), Ewok Village, and I Feel The Conflict.'' For remainder of game, you may not deploy [Episode I] or [Episode VII] characters or locations (except Obi-Wan{{Errata hl|1=, Yoda,}} and {{Errata hl|1=Lars' Moisture Farm}}). {{Errata hl|1=If}} Luke {{Errata hl|1=just won a battle,}} may {{Errata hl|1=re-circulate and shuffle Reserve Deck. Emperor's Power does}} not {{Errata hl|1=increase deploy costs at battlegrounds}}. '''While''' this side up, you may initiate battles for free. '''Flip''' this card if Luke or a Jedi at a battleground site (unless an opponent's character of ability &gt; 4 is).<br />'''7 side — He Will Bring Balance'''<br />'''While''' this side up, once during your control phase, may peek at up to X cards from the top of your Reserve Deck, where X = number of battlegrounds you occupy; take one into hand and shuffle your Reserve Deck. During your draw phase, may retrieve any one card; opponent may stack a card from hand on I Feel The Conflict to place that card out of play instead. '''Flip''' this card (unless Vader crossed over) if opponent's character of ability &gt; 4 at a battleground site or you do not have Luke (or a Jedi) at a battleground site. || '''0 side — He Is The Chosen One'''<br />''Deploy Anakin's Funeral Pyre (with Prophecy Of The '''For'''ce there), Ewok Village, and I Feel The Conflict.'' For remainder of game, you may not deploy [Episode I] or [Episode VII] characters or locations (except Obi-Wan, Yoda, and Lars' Moisture Farm). If Luke just won a battle, may re-circulate and shuffle Reserve Deck. Emperor's Power does not increase deploy costs at battlegrounds. '''While''' this side up, you may initiate battles for free. '''Flip''' this card if Luke or a Jedi at a battleground site (unless an opponent's character of ability &gt; 4 is).<br />'''7 side — He Will Bring Balance'''<br />'''While''' this side up, once during your control phase, may peek at up to X cards from the top of your Reserve Deck, where X = number of battlegrounds you occupy; take one into hand and shuffle your Reserve Deck. During your draw phase, may retrieve any one card; opponent may stack a card from hand {{Errata hl|1=face down}} on I Feel The Conflict to place that card out of play instead. '''Flip''' this card (unless Vader crossed over) if opponent's character of ability &gt; 4 at a battleground site or you do not have Luke (or a Jedi) at a battleground site.

== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Modern [[He Is The Chosen One / He Will Bring Balance]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column. Words a later column removed are highlighted in the column before it. Same-words image changes are not columns: [[He Is The Chosen One / He Will Bring Balance (Errata 2)]] shares the [[He Is The Chosen One / He Will Bring Balance (Errata)]] column; [[He Is The Chosen One / He Will Bring Balance (Errata 4)]] shares the [[He Is The Chosen One / He Will Bring Balance (Errata 3)]] column; [[He Is The Chosen One / He Will Bring Balance (Errata 6)]] shares the [[He Is The Chosen One / He Will Bring Balance (Errata 5)]] column.
